title: Escolher Onde Não Estar
summary: Adrian cancels the preliminary VALORANT project, concentrates Kairos on League and Counter-Strike, and places Dota 2 under long-term monitoring only.
keyEvents: The preliminary VALORANT project is cancelled, not paused; no roster, staff, contracts, or competitive participation ever existed.
League has 15 players across three rosters, Counter-Strike has 10 across two, for 25 competitive players total.
Dota 2 is long-term monitoring only, without active recruitment, staff search, or launch timeline.
